title: Below: Statue of Liberty
subtitle: A tentacle takes a patrol boat in front of the Statue of Liberty
description: For the launch of *Below*, Netflix’s creature series set off the coast of Newfoundland, the monster had to surface where everyone would see it. From the deck of a ferry in New York Harbor, a red patrol boat passes Liberty Island. A tentacle breaks the surface, wraps the hull, flips it and takes it under, propellers still spinning in the air.

Posted on Netflix’s main Instagram account on 12 October 2026, four days after the premiere: 56.8 million views in eight days. The boat, the tentacles and every wave and splash around them are 3D: animation first, then water, foam and spray simulations, frame by frame.
toCheck: Projet ajouté le 20/10/2026. Sources : fichiers livrés fournis par Mehdi le 20/10/2026, channels Slack #1-, #2-, #3-below-netflix-intern et #below-ooh-netflix-intern (septembre-octobre 2026), Tudum / What's on Netflix pour la série (6 épisodes, sortie le 08/10/2026, Terre-Neuve). Reel @netflix DeZ3RDsCrNc publié le 12/10/2026 (heure US). 56,8 M de vues au 20/10 (capture de Mehdi).

title: Below: Niagara Falls
subtitle: The same creature, under the Horseshoe Falls
description: The second sighting, at the foot of the Horseshoe Falls. From the rail of a boat in the spray, a patrol boat flying the Canadian flag is caught between two tentacles, dragged under and thrown back up, engines out of the water.

Posted on Netflix Canada’s Instagram account the same day as the New York film: 456K views. Two countries, two landmarks, one creature. The series is set in a small Newfoundland town; the films took it to the places people already film on their phones.
toCheck: Projet ajouté le 20/10/2026. Sources : fichiers livrés fournis par Mehdi le 20/10/2026, channels Slack #1-, #2-, #3-below-netflix-intern et #below-ooh-netflix-intern (septembre-octobre 2026), Tudum / What's on Netflix pour la série (6 épisodes, sortie le 08/10/2026, Terre-Neuve). Reel @netflixca DeZ8aBAj49u publié le 12/10/2026. 456K vues au 20/10 (capture de Mehdi). Drapeau canadien demandé par Netflix (Slack, 15/09).

title: Zalando Lounge
subtitle: A whole season’s finds, balanced on a Paris bench
description: For Zalando Lounge’s seasonal campaign, a model stands on a Paris bench and pours tea into a cup that sits on a vase, on a glass, on a pair of sneakers, on a handbag, on a pair of glasses, on a red bag, on a speaker. Fashion, accessories and homeware in one impossible stack, on a real street, in the autumn light.
A film built to say one thing: it is surprising what you can find when you know where to look. Real shoot, CGI stack, no cut. Close to a million views and still climbing.

title: AVATAR: THE LAST AIRBENDER
subtitle: Earth Kingdom Public Works: a cracked Los Angeles sidewalk, fixed by earthbenders
description: Five days before season 2 of *Avatar: The Last Airbender*, a green stencil appeared on a broken Los Angeles sidewalk: Earth Kingdom Public Works. The tag was real, sprayed on a real crack. Then the film: a foot steps on it, the concrete splits, the earth shifts, and the sidewalk opens onto the Earth Kingdom before the season’s footage takes over.

Posted on the Netflix Avatar account as the launch of the earthbenders. People went to find the tag in the street. The post passed 30K likes, the account went past 650K followers, and the comments did the rest.
toCheck: Projet ajouté le 28/09/2026 hors export Framer, reel fourni par Mehdi (post @avatarnetflix du 20/06/2026, format carré 28 s : le tag, le trottoir qui s’ouvre, puis les images de la saison 2). Faits donnés par Mehdi, non vérifiés : +30K likes, compte à +650K abonnés, des gens sont allés chercher le tag. Le poster de la tuile est un plan du reel (le tag, la fissure).

title: Privé by Zalando
subtitle: A giant tennis ball on the Fontaine de l’Observatoire, for the tennis season
description: Privé by Zalando’s first event activation, with one objective: make the Paris tennis season feel like a Privé by Zalando moment. Our film puts a giant tennis ball on top of the Fontaine de l’Observatoire, at the foot of the Luxembourg gardens, a scoreboard in the brand’s purple, and a player serving from the edge of the basin. title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
subtitle: Yoshi eggs on the shelf of a New York grocery store
description: Imagined by the agency for the release of *The Super Mario Galaxy Movie*: a carton of Yoshi eggs, green spots and all, sitting in the egg aisle of a New York grocery store. The carton carries the film’s artwork and its release date, 1 April 2026, and the film is shot like someone who just found it.

One product that never existed, filmed as if it did. The video reached 5 million views on its own, was picked up across the internet with 15 million earned media impressions and 500K engagements, and cost nothing in paid media. The comment that came back most: “wish it was real”.

title: BIG MISTAKES I
subtitle: The night the 4.9.26 necklace was stolen from a Sunset Boulevard billboard
